notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla defines the full chat-channel subsystem: CMSG_JOIN/LEAVE_CHANNEL, CMSG_CHANNEL_LIST/PASSWORD/OWNER/SET_OWNER/MODERATOR/UNMODERATOR/MUTE/UNMUTE/INVITE/KICK/BAN/UNBAN/ANNOUNCEMENTS/MODERATE (shared cstrings body), SMSG_CHANNEL_NOTIFY (32 notice types with per-notice tails), and SMSG_CHANNEL_LIST (roster). MSUI has none of it - the only trace is a comment in Engine/UI/ChatFrameLaw.cs; no channel opcode exists even in Net/Opcodes.cs.
